Manual FPDF install target
==========================

Place official Setasign FPDF files in this folder:

- application/third_party/fpdf/fpdf.php
- application/third_party/fpdf/font/helvetica.php
- application/third_party/fpdf/font/helveticab.php
- application/third_party/fpdf/font/courier.php
- application/third_party/fpdf/font/times.php

Optional (recommended):
- include all font/*.php files from FPDF package.

Source:
https://github.com/Setasign/FPDF

After copying, test endpoint:
/api/student/course-registration/template?email=<student-email>

Expected:
Browser downloads "course_registration_form.pdf" with populated data.
